# Project Sentinel
> Runtime & Sandbox Research Platform: 60 LLM-persona agents (Big Five
> personalities) plus 5 background services run under bwrap + Landlock + cgroups
> isolation. The simulated office (PixelPerfekt GmbH, fictional, Truman-Show-style)
> is the evaluation context for runtime hardening, controlplane experiments and
> agent control loops.

## Architecture (read first)
- [docs/architecture/togaf-architecture-guide.html](docs/architecture/togaf-architecture-guide.html): TOGAF v22.1 — authoritative architecture reference (10 clusters)
- [docs/governance.md](docs/governance.md): Governance mechanisms mapped to code paths
- [docs/togaf-gap-v22.md](docs/togaf-gap-v22.md): Per-cluster implementation status
- [docs/togaf-deviations-v22.md](docs/togaf-deviations-v22.md): Deviation register (DEV-001/002/003)
- [docs/glossary.md](docs/glossary.md): PixelPerfekt narrative, agent-layer model, terminology

## Agent Layers
- 60 LLM-persona agents (51 on 3-shift rotation, 9 always-on duty staff)
- 5 background service agents: sentinel-daemon, cortex-gateway, sentinel-judge, sentinel-nightrun, sentinel-nats-bridge
- Approximately 26 LLM agents active at any given moment (17 shift + 9 always-on)

## Core Components (Rust + Go)
- [crates/sentinel-ecs](crates/sentinel-ecs/): Rust ECS world simulation (bevy_ecs). Deterministic physics, biology, acoustics.
- [crates/sentinel-bio](crates/sentinel-bio/): Bio-Engine. Differential equations for hunger, caffeine (t½=5.7h), bladder, stress, energy.
- [crates/sentinel-physics](crates/sentinel-physics/): Matrix Physics. Noise (30dB base + 5dB/person), smell propagation, temperature, CO2.
- [cmd/cortex-gateway](cmd/cortex-gateway/): Go LLM proxy. 7-step pipeline. Synthesis engine. Controlplane.
- [services/sentinel-judge](services/sentinel-judge/): Quality & drift monitoring (NATS streaming + LLM analysis).
- [services/sentinel-nightrun](services/sentinel-nightrun/): Nightly batch consolidation, deterministic replay, hash chain.
- [services/sentinel-nats-bridge](services/sentinel-nats-bridge/): eBPF metrics dual-publish.
- [dashboard](dashboard/): Bun + Hono real-time dashboard with WebSocket.

## Infrastructure
- [crates/sentinel-zenoh](crates/sentinel-zenoh/): Zenoh pub/sub (shared-memory local <10μs, TCP distributed).
- [crates/sentinel-redb](crates/sentinel-redb/): Pure Rust ACID KV-store for hot state.
- [crates/sentinel-limbo](crates/sentinel-limbo/): Async SQLite event store (append-only, idempotent).
- [crates/sentinel-sandbox](crates/sentinel-sandbox/): Agent isolation via bwrap + Landlock + cgroups v2 + netns.
- [crates/sentinel-wasm](crates/sentinel-wasm/): WASM tool runtime (Wasmtime).
- [crates/sentinel-ebpf](crates/sentinel-ebpf/): eBPF monitoring (aya-rs). Zero-overhead kernel probes.

## Configuration
- [config/agents](config/agents/): 60 agent personality definitions (TOML, Big Five).
- [config/rooms.toml](config/rooms.toml): Office layout (26 rooms, 2 floors, adjacency graph).
- [config/simulation.toml](config/simulation.toml): Simulation parameters (tick rate, thresholds).

## Key Patterns
- **Neuro-Symbolic AI**: ECS (symbolic, deterministic) + LLM (neural, probabilistic)
- **Perception Injection**: `[SYSTEM_INJECTION]...[/SYSTEM_INJECTION]` blocks transparently injected before each LLM call
- **Synthesis Engine**: 10 deterministic rules intercept ~70% of routine perceptions before they hit the real LLM
- **Fourth-Wall Detection**: Regex + LLM-Judge detects when agent realizes it's AI → re-generation
- **NMDA Night-Run**: Shift-change memory consolidation via background service (no model training)
- **Native Controlplane Kernel**: observe → decide → act → verify (every auto-action with rollback condition + TTL)

## Sandbox Verification
9/9 breakout tests passing (bwrap + Landlock + cgroups + netns).
See [docs/security-test-report.md](docs/security-test-report.md).

## Building
- Rust: `cargo remote -- build --workspace` (build server configurable via .make.local)
- Go: `cd cmd/cortex-gateway && go build ./...`
- Dashboard: `cd dashboard && bun install && bun run dev`
- All: `make build`
- Tests: `make test`
- CI: 16 GitHub Workflows (cargo-deny, CodeQL, OSSF Scorecard, Renovate, Coverage)

## Demo
```
make demo                               # one command: build + run + open dashboard
# or: docker compose -f docker-compose.demo.yml up
```
5 agents, 10-minute simulation. Dashboard: http://localhost:18000 (port 18000
because 8000 is commonly taken). See README.md "What the docker demo shows
— and what it does not" for the kernel-feature limitations of running this
stack inside Docker.
